title: "Project GENETRIX balloon launch" – Air Force reconnaissance balloon (p. 84)
description: Black-and-white photograph of a tall, partially inflated balloon rising into a dark sky with a suspended payload beneath it, while a small group of people stand silhouetted on the ground below. Captioned "Project GENETRIX balloon launch." It accompanies the section "The Impact of the Air Force Project GENETRIX Balloons," describing camera-carrying balloons sent over Eastern Europe and the Soviet Union.
